description: AT-26 Xavante FAB 4493 (about 7,000 flight hours, retired 2010) mounted on a 4 m concrete pylon on 26 Oct 2015 to mark 31 years of Base Aérea de Boa Vista; restored by the Esquadrão Escorpião. Listed as a city landmark by the Prefeitura (2021) and in a Feb 2026 compilation.
